chunks: ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

About a man who prays the Fajr prayer as one rakʿah, then recites the tashahhud, finishes, goes away and comes back, then remembers that he had only prayed one rakʿah. He said: “He adds to it one rakʿah.”

key_terms.إِلَيْهَا: to it, meaning to the prayer
key_terms.رَكْعَةً: a single rakʿah unit of prayer
key_terms.وَيَنْصَرِفُ: he finishes and turns away from the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he remembers after finishing Fajr prayer that he prayed only one rakʿah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about forgetfulness in salat (prayer), specifically in the Fajr prayer. If a person completed only one rakʿah and later remembered, he is to add one more rakʿah to complete the prayer.
